help.title: How to use — FarmMeasure
help.lang: 🌐 Regional languages: switch between English and हिन्दी from Languages (☰ menu on mobile, 🌐 button on desktop). Reports print in the same language.
help.s1li2: Tap corners of your field on the map. For uneven edges, add more points.
help.s1li3: Close the shape: tap the first point or press <kbd>Enter</kbd> / double-tap.
help.s1li4: Drag points or the shape to adjust. Use ✎ Edit or 🗑 Delete on each field.
help.s1li5: Draw only the area you want measured — leave out ponds, rocky patches, or houses; anything outside your polygon is not counted.
help.s2li1: Standard units (top of panel): m², sq ft, hectares, acres, gaj, are, km², sq mi — govt record truth (ha/acre).
help.s2li2: Totals and each field update instantly. Secondary line shows 3 other units for quick compare.
help.s3li1: Below the totals, pick State unit e.g. Cent — Andhra Pradesh or Bigha — Rajasthan (Vigha Pucca).
help.s3li2: Both totals and each field show the converted value. 1 acre = X state units is shown for cross-check with your patwari.
help.s3li3: Your choice is remembered on this device. Share PDF/GeoJSON — it carries the m² value, so anyone can view in their own units.
help.s4li1: Rotate: Hold Shift + scroll, or two-finger twist on mobile, or use the compass (top-left). Tap compass to reset north. Rotation helps align fields to screen.
help.s4li2: Satellite ↔ Map: Use layer switcher top-right. Satellite shows bunds clearly.
help.s4li3: Find me: Tap Use my location to center — your location dot appears, not stored.
help.s4li4: Import: Drag a .geojson/.kml file onto the panel footer or tap Import.
help.s4li5: Thin bunds: Use the ◐ clarity and HD buttons — top-left on desktop, top-right on mobile — to sharpen faint boundaries. HD uses more data.
help.foot: All calculations happen on your device. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap / MapTiler. Indicative measurement only — not a legal survey. All values are for reference; whoever generates a report must verify it against revenue records or a licensed surveyor.
